From our kitchen to your table

Small kitchen.
Whole lot of heart.

Welcome to GL Cakes & Pastries, a home baking business with a simple idea: the sweetest moments are the ones we share.

Whether it’s the centrepiece of a celebration or a small treat at the end of a long day, there’s always a good reason to gather around something delicious.

Here’s to the sweet moments.
